text: “I wish to speak with Monsieur Aramis. Is that your name, monsieur?” “My very own. You have brought me something?” “Yes, if you show me a certain embroidered handkerchief.” “Here it is,” said Aramis, taking a small key from his breast and opening a little ebony box inlaid with mother of pearl, “here it is. Look.” “That is right,” replied the mendicant; “dismiss your lackey.” In fact, Bazin, curious to know what the mendicant could want with his master, kept pace with him as well as he could, and arrived almost at the same time he did; but his quickness was not of much use to him. At the hint from the mendicant his master made him a sign to retire, and he was obliged to obey.
